reason: The plugin primarily provides an SSH-backed terminal tool for executing Bash commands on remote Linux servers, with persisted connection management and workspace defaults; its remote execution capability warrants human review.

summaries.zh: 通过 SSH 在远程 Linux 服务器上执行 Bash 命令，并管理持久化连接和工作区默认设置。
summaries.en: Executes Bash commands on remote Linux servers over SSH while managing persisted connections and workspace defaults.

capabilities: Executes Bash commands on remote Linux servers over SSH
Stores SSH connection metadata and workspace-specific defaults
Reads and parses local OpenSSH configuration aliases
Provides a settings interface for managing saved connections
